title: Google Pay Payment Handler Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the com.google.pay payment handler.

api_version.description: The major Google Pay API version. Currently, this must be 2.

api_version_minor.description: The minor Google Pay API version. Currently, this must be 0.

merchant_info.description: Identity details for the merchant as required by the Google Pay UCP handler.

merchant_name.description: The user-facing name of the merchant that will appear on the Google Pay payment sheet.

merchant_id.description: The Google Pay Merchant ID. Use a dummy value or 'TEST' for the TEST environment as configured in the handler configuration; use the real Merchant ID for PRODUCTION.

merchant_origin.description: The fully qualified domain name where the checkout occurs, used for origin validation.

auth_jwt.description: An optional authorization JWT for certain integration contexts.

items.description: Configuration options for an allowed payment method and its tokenization or processing specifications.

type.description: An identifier for the type of supported payment method. CARD is the only supported value.

parameters.description: Parameters required to configure the provided payment method type. For the CARD type use CardParameters.

allowed_auth_methods.description: Fields supported to authenticate a card transaction. PAN_ONLY returns PAN and expiration for cards on file with the user's Google Account.

allowed_card_networks.description: The card networks supported by the merchant and the Google Pay API.

allow_prepaid_cards.description: Set to false if you don't support prepaid cards. Default is true.

allow_credit_cards.description: Set to false if you don't support credit cards. Default is true.

assurance_details_required.description: Set to true to request assurance details.

billing_address_required.description: Set to true if you require a billing address.

billing_address_parameters.description: The expected fields returned if billing_address_required is set to true.

format.description: Billing address format required to complete the transaction.

phone_number_required.description: Set to true if a phone number is required to process the transaction.

tokenization_specification.description: Configure an account or decryption provider to receive payment information. This property is required for the CARD payment method.

type.description: A payment method tokenization type is supported for the given PaymentMethod. For the CARD payment method, use PAYMENT_GATEWAY or DIRECT.

parameters.description: Parameters specific to the selected payment method tokenization type.

allowed_payment_methods.description: The payment methods allowed for this transaction.
